title: 📖 First Flight: The Proposal
body: Welcome to Chapter 9: 'The Proposal'. Let us discover the story together through thoughtful reading and analysis.

title: Chapter 9 Summary: The Proposal
body: A one-act comedy by Anton Chekhov. Lomov visits his neighbour Chubukov to propose to his daughter Natalya. However, before he can propose, they get into absurd quarrels about the ownership of Oxen Meadows and dogs.
body_hi: एंटोन चेखव की एक-अंकीय कॉमेडी। लोमोव अपने पड़ोसी की बेटी से शादी का प्रस्ताव देने आता है।

question: After reading the summary of 'The Proposal', what questions come to your mind? What would you like to explore further?
question_hi: 'प्रस्ताव' का सारांश पढ़ने के बाद, आपके मन में कौन से प्रश्न आते हैं?
explanation: Generating your own questions is the key to deep reading comprehension.
explanation_hi: अपने प्रश्न बनाना गहरी पठन समझ की कुंजी है।
